name: Sakura Riches 60

features.name: Lantern wilds
features.description: Substitute for all symbols except the scatter.

review:
Sakura Riches 60 is a serene Asian slot with drifting sakura petals, hand fans, lotus flowers and Chinese lanterns, which act as the wild. As the name suggests, it uses a 60-line structure.

The lantern wild substitutes for every symbol except the scatter. BGaming's published description is short, but the numbers are notable: very high volatility, a 3,000x maximum and a 97.16% RTP. Try it in demo to see how the scatter feature plays out. It's a calm-looking game with surprisingly swingy maths.
pros: Excellent 97.16% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
